meta_description:
9,890 likes, 116 comments - anoushkalila on October 5, 2026: "In and around Scotland in Autumn, my very favourite time of year to explore what is possibly my favourite part of the UK (excluding London obvs). Swipe to explore some of the prettiest spots we discovered on last years Scottish Autumn road trip 👉🏼

Best places in Scotland | Scotland in Autumn | Autumn colours in Scotland | UK Travel Destinations

Golden hour over Drummond Castle Gardens, the prettiest gardens in all of Scotland (although I’ll admit, I haven’t seen them all…yet)

@cromlixhotel, the cosiest of Autumnal stays nestled in the most beautiful woodland.

An early morning exploring Dean Village, Edinburgh. Will definitely be repeating this outfit all Autumn, checks and browns are my go-tos the second the leaves start to turn.

Another angle of Dean Village.

Lunch in style at @thewitcheryedin, Scotland’s spookiest hotel - and a meal you simply cannot miss in Edinburgh.

A gloomy day on the Isle of Skye.

@barbour wellies are a necessity when the forecast is endless rain, which is often the case in Scotland come Autumn (at least in my experience!)

Highland coos are honestly one of the main reasons to visit Scotland imo. So coo-te (see what I did there?)

Stormy skies over Eilean Donan castle, just another one of Scotland’s many epic castles.

The fairy glen on Isle of Skye. Sadly the unique fairy circles weren’t particularly prominent when we visited, but it’s still a wonderful part of Scotland to explore - and on my list to return too, hopefully when it’s less rainy…".
